snippet.title: Microlandia 1.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
With cozy voxel-based graphics inspired by classics like the original SimCity, and a brutally detailed simulation behind the hood. Life of your virtual citizens is rich with complex details based in true life statistics and studies.

Official Website: https://microlandia.city
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4094120/Microlandia/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/infosuperhighway.bsky.social
Instagram: http://instagram.com/information.superhighway
